Rules:

- Do not repeat the exact instruction in the conversation. Instead, use your own words to convey the same information.
- Try to make the conversation as natural as possible, and stick to the personalities in the instruction.
Hi! How can I help you today?

- Silver, medium brightness, USB — $164.97

Which option would you like instead? Also, please note that any price difference will be paid or refunded via a payment method — you currently have a gift card on file, so let me know if you'd like to use that. And please confirm this is the only item you'd like to modify, since item modifications can only be done once per order.
